facts.claim: Carnival Adventure (Carnival Cruise Line): Entered service 2001; 108,865 GT; 2640 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Grand class.
Carnival Adventure is a Grand-class cruise ship operated by Carnival Cruise Line.
The ship was previously named Golden Princess and Pacific Adventure.
In 2007, she circumnavigated South America and debuted along the West Coast of the United States before also sailing around ports in Asia and Oceania bordering the Pacific Ocean until 2020.

catalogSpecs.description: Formerly Golden Princess, then Pacific Adventure (P&O Australia). Rebranded Carnival Adventure in March 2025 when P&O Cruises Australia folded into Carnival Cruise Line. Homeported in Sydney.
